# Tailrocks: gRPC Review

`tailrocks-grpc-review` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-grpc-review)

Review a gRPC diff or audit a cross-service surface without editing. Report verified proto, Buf, tonic/prost, status, deadline, operations, and wire-test findings. Use tailrocks-grpc-best-practices for evolution.
